prompt_en: An urgent handheld documentary photograph at night: an unmistakably adult witch with pointed cat ears visible against the sky rides a single wooden broom under a dark moon. The broom's nose and her knees point along the flight path; her thighs grip its shaft and her left hand holds the forward shaft. She twists her shoulders over her right side and extends her right arm behind her, firing a bright defensive magic bolt backward along the chase line. A modern KF-21 fighter jet pursues from behind and below, smaller in the same frame, with its angular twin-tail silhouette caught in cold moonlight; the bolt travels toward its approach path. The camera tracks slightly ahead of her right flank, showing her right arm and the jet beyond the trailing bristles. The witch and broom dominate the near foreground while the pursuing fighter remains clearly recognizable through a break in wind-torn cloud. Its grip-worn wooden shaft runs unbroken beneath her thighs, and the compressed brush bristles trail in the same stream as her coat. The witch's near silhouette sits off center against open sky, counterweighted by the smaller jet across the luminous diagonal of her shot. A 35mm documentary lens keeps her working hand, the broom fibers, and the jet's wing roots in one hurried field of view. Her coat and hair stream backward toward the pursuer, and a slanted horizon conveys a split-second evasive maneuver. Cold blue moonlight outlines the ears, face, broom, and aircraft, while the magical discharge briefly lights her braced arm. Real lens grain, slight edge motion smear, atmospheric haze, and an imperfect off-center capture make the scene feel physically photographed during sudden danger.
negative_en: 3D render look, excessive HDR, unrealistic hands, low resolution, distorted fingers, cartoon style, over-processed retouching, broken facial features
